svg.title: Orthogonality drift under repeated rotation
svg.desc: Forty-eight points on the unit circle are rotated repeatedly by the same Givens rotation, computed in fp8, bfloat16, binary16 and posit<16,2>, and rotated back exactly so that only the error remains. The chart below shows the largest radius error against the number of rotations.
svg.text: The unit circle after k computed rotations (rotated back exactly)
